title: Five-Minute Quickstart
content:
1. docker compose up -d
2. curl http://localhost:14800/healthz
3. POST /v1/query/text-search with query and tenant_id
4. PUT /v1/facts to store a fact
5. corecruxctl verify-store --data-dir ./data

title: Appending Events
content: POST /v1/append with tenant_id, stream_type, stream_id, and events array. Each event needs event_id, occurred_at (RFC3339), event_type, and payload (JSON string).

title: Text Search
content: POST /v1/query/text-search with tenant_id and query. Optional: token_budget (fill until budget), min_score (relevance floor), mode=scan (metadata only).

title: Fact Store
content: PUT /v1/facts to store. GET /v1/facts?query=... to search. GET /v1/facts/entity/{name} by entity. DELETE /v1/facts/{id} to soft-delete.

title: Session Store
content: PUT /v1/sessions/{id}/state with JSON body. GET /v1/sessions/{id}/state to retrieve. State persists across requests within the session.

title: Architecture
content: 14 Rust crates. corecruxd is the HTTP+gRPC daemon on port 14800. Append-only event store with sealed segments. .ccxi companion indexes for BM25. CROWN receipts on every operation.

title: Configuration
content: All config via environment variables. CORECRUXD_DATA_DIR (data), CORECRUXD_HTTP_PORT (default 14800), CORECRUXD_BUILD_CCXI (index building), CORECRUXD_QUERY_TEXT_SEARCH (enable search).
